1.title: Democrat Graham Platner suspends campaign for key US Senate race after assault allegation
1.summary: The decision came days after a woman accused him of sexual assault, an accusation he says is "categorically false".

2.title: Inside the Implosion of Graham Platner’s Maine Senate Campaign: ‘A Slow-Rolling Disaster’
2.summary: Graham Platner’s bid for the Senate inspired progressive Democrats. But the campaign, which he suspended Wednesday, was messy, disorganized and ultimately doomed by a steady drip of scandal.

3.title: Graham Platner Suspended His Senate Campaign. Here’s What’s Next for Democrats.
3.summary: The deadline to pick a new nominee is July 27 and candidates are already lining up. State party leaders said they would hold some form of nominating convention.

4.title: Ukrainians Cautiously Welcome Trump’s Announcement About Air-Defense Systems
4.summary: President Trump said the United States would license Ukraine to produce Patriots, which can intercept ballistic missiles. But it could be months or years before those are ready.

5.title: Live Updates: U.S. and Iran Sink Into Violent Cycle After Latest Strikes
5.summary: Attacks on ships were followed by new U.S. strikes on Iran, which responded by firing at Gulf nations. The pattern of hostilities has all but collapsed a cease-fire, with little sign that either side will step back.

6.title: Final Stage of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei’s Funeral Begins After Delay
6.summary: Thousands gathered for the procession in Mashhad for the supreme leader, who was killed in the first U.S.-Israeli attacks of the war. Hours earlier, the United States and Iran traded strikes.
